Two recommended ways to improve the comprehensibility and accountability of algorithmic systems for users, according to the CNIL report, are:

1. Establishing an obligation for the responsible parties of algorithmic systems to provide clear and understandable information about the logic of the algorithms, ensuring that users can comprehend how decisions are made.

2. Creating a national platform for auditing algorithms to ensure their compliance with the law and their fairness, which would enhance the capacity of public authorities to oversee and hold accountable the algorithms in use.
